gate.string: The '9 of 9' precision figure in circulation is the pre-commit gate's 8 of 8 pooled with a separate run's 1 of 1: nine correct precision draws of nine, arithmetically exact, resolved 2026-08-14. Not a report error; two runs' figures were being read as one. The sampler values were never in dispute.

nothink.string: Measured: suppressing thinking collapses this family's judgment (open questions captured 19 -> 0), so judgment keeps thinking and only extraction is safe without it.

preserve_thinking.string: Load-bearing for cache cleanliness: with it off, the prefix a fork re-sends is not byte-identical to what the session sent, and the fork prefills cold. Must never leave the launch line.

thinking_kwarg.string: the /no_think soft switch is DEAD on this model; the kwarg is the only working control.

gate.string: needs majority vote (5) even to review; a single sample is not enough on this model.

note.string: needs an explicit proactive-capture prompt; Gemma captures reactively where Qwen captures proactively.

nothink.string: no-think is SAFE broadly here — judgment stayed robust (18 -> 17), the opposite of Qwen.

preserve_thinking.string: absent by spec on this model.

sampler.string: Measured on the cross-model run: the model card's temp 1.0 / top_k 64 / top_p 0.95 is REQUIRED; temp 0 made real capability look absent.
